card.name: The word entire before contents
card.fires_on: The word "entire" right before "contents" in directions to open a capsule or packet and sprinkle, pour or mix it. It fires when "contents" is the expected next word.

modes.label: Opened capsules

modes.label: Packets and sachets
modes.description: "entire" follows "the" in directions to empty a packet or sachet into liquid or onto food.

card.writes: It pushes the model to output "contents" (and its translations) as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the word "entire" in directions to empty a whole capsule or packet, just before "contents" comes up.
